name: AFRA 2345
title: Language and Racism
description: (Also offered as COGS 2345.) Examines the relationships between language use, both historically and across the lifespan, and the social construction of race, racism, and racial identity, with particular emphasis on racial politics in the United States.
requirement_description: Open to sophomores or higher. Recommended preparation: One course in AFRA or COGS.
